book.name: Paihowa
book.title: PAIHOWA Yesu ꞌana tohepwailao ꞌidi paihowa

content: Ta Paulo meYudiya ꞌidi babadaowedi ꞌiꞌeꞌebubudiya, ta ꞌihegwaediya, “Babadao ma tasigwao, mwalona ma nige toꞌaha yanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌina loinao beno yamuliya bwaibwainidiya.”
Ma Ananaiyasi, tauna Topwaoli Madouna, ꞌihegwaediya taudi Paulo deina sitotoholo ꞌabehega Paulo ꞌahwana sisapi.

Ta Paulo ꞌihegwae hileya, ꞌigwae, “Yehoba wete ꞌisapigo, weyahina ꞌowa tuwa ꞌa ꞌita bwebweꞌana, ma solauwa gala madouna! Cabehega beno ꞌoina ꞌumiyatoi ma ꞌuloinegau Mosese ꞌina loinega, ta ꞌowa hesi loinaina ꞌuligehiya, weyahina ꞌugwae ꞌabehega sisapigau?”
Ta taudi sitotoholo Paulo deina sigwaeya, “Togidega ta Yehoba ꞌina Topwaoli Madouna ꞌoina ꞌuꞌahwaꞌahwa paꞌala, ꞌawa?”
Ta Paulo ꞌigwaeya, “Yauwedo tasigwao! Geya yasanapu ꞌabehega tauna Topwaoli Madouna. Moisa tuwa Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila gidemusa ꞌigwae, ꞌSahena ꞌimi toloina ꞌoina ꞌuꞌahwaꞌahwa paꞌala.’”

Bewa tuwa Paulo ꞌiꞌiteya ꞌabehega toꞌetoꞌautaedi boda ꞌeluwa ꞌoidiyega, ꞌaigeda Sadusiyao, ma ꞌaigeda Palisiyao, ma ꞌoidiya ꞌibwau latuwa, ꞌigwae, “Tasigwao, taugu ꞌaigeda Palisi ꞌidi boda, weyahina tamagu wete Palisi ꞌidi boda, ta ꞌigu yatala bewa lamuna yahemisa ꞌabehega toꞌamasa sitoholo hila.”
Ta Paulo ꞌina gwae bewa weyahina Palisiyao ma Sadusiyao siheꞌoheꞌohena, ta hegogonaina siwatahiya.

Weyahina Sadusiyao sigwae toꞌamasa geya sowasowahina ma sitoholo hila, ta wete sigwae, ꞌabehega aneloseyao nuwana yaluyaluwao geya ꞌaigeda wete ꞌimiyamiya, ma hesi Palisiyao sihemisa ꞌabehega nata moisa toꞌamasa sitoholo hilama, ma wete sisanapuya ꞌabehega moisa Yehoba ꞌina aneloseyao ma yaluyaluwao simiyamiya.

Nage ꞌoina yatala bahobaho ꞌilatuwa, ꞌoinega Palisiyao ꞌidi loinao ꞌadi toheꞌitao tupwadi sitoholowa ma sigwaeya, “Loheya bewa, geya ꞌeta wete ꞌina pui ꞌoinega ꞌaloba. Ma hesi ꞌina nuwatuhu bewa, nuwana Yehoba ꞌina anelose bo yaluyaluwa ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌeweya.”

Nage ꞌoina siꞌoheꞌohe madouna, ta ꞌaleha ꞌana toloina ꞌimatauta. Cina nuwatuhu ꞌabehega nata Paulo siꞌabiyahi ma ꞌabwa hesi siꞌabi hegala bwaibwaini. Coinega toloꞌalehaedi ꞌiloinaediya ma Paulo bodaedi ꞌoidiyega sitoeya, sitauyeya hadai.

Eeta hadai ꞌimiya heboiya, ma nihuwanega ꞌina Bada ꞌilatuma Paulo deina, ꞌitoholowa ma ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Paulo, sahena ꞌuꞌateꞌateyoho, weyahina Yelusalema ꞌoina ꞌuhepwaila pwaigauwa. Ma Loma ꞌoina wete gidemusa ꞌabwa ꞌuhepwaila ꞌesegau.”
Cidi loina dahwana Paulo ꞌana loheꞌamasa weyahina
Hali sabwelowega meYudiya siꞌetoꞌautama, ꞌidi nuwatuhu siꞌatububudiya, ma wete sigwae hemisa ma geyaꞌabwa siꞌaiꞌai bo sinumanuma ꞌana siga Paulo siloheꞌamasi.
Bodaedi bewa siꞌetoꞌauta ma nuwatuhu bewa gidemusa silaguya, ꞌadi baibaiwa gide poti ꞌiꞌebesineya.
Muliyetega, sitauya topwaoliyao ma babadao ꞌoidiya, sigwaeya, “Tauma bewa ꞌagwae hemisa pwaiya ma ꞌabehega geyaꞌabwa ꞌeta toꞌaha ꞌaꞌapuꞌaputoho ꞌana siga Paulo ꞌaloheꞌamasi.

Coinega ꞌomi ma babadao mahetemiyao watauya boda ꞌaleha ꞌana toloina waꞌabowe, ma Paulo ꞌitoeyama, ta ꞌina pui taꞌebese bwaibwaini. Ma ꞌoinega tauma ꞌaꞌatububuwa, ma saugaina ꞌeguma ꞌeda ꞌoina sitautauyama ꞌaloheꞌamasi.”
Ta Paulo ꞌina hewali, tauna wahana, toloheꞌamasaedi ꞌidi teba tetelina ꞌihesagoheya, ta ꞌiluhuwa hadai, ta Paulo ꞌoina ꞌihepwaila.
Ta Paulo toloꞌalehao ꞌidi tohanugeta ꞌaigeda ꞌibwauweyama, ta ꞌihegwaeya. “Hewali bewa ꞌutauye boda ꞌaleha ꞌana toloina ꞌoina ma toꞌaha ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌihepwaila ꞌoina.”
Ta ꞌitoeya toloinaina ꞌoina, ta ꞌihegwaeya, “Paulo deliya ꞌimiyamiya ꞌibwauwegauwa ma ꞌihegwaegauwa ꞌabehega hewaliina bewa yatoeyama, ma toꞌaha ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌihepwaila ꞌoiuwa.”
Ta toloinaina hewaliina ꞌiꞌabi nimeya ma sihanaowa tupwana, ma siboidimo ma ꞌihesilaleya, ꞌigwae, “Toꞌaha ꞌabehega ꞌoiguwa ꞌuhepwaile?”
Ta hewaliina ꞌigwaeya, “MeYudiya siloina ma ꞌabehega siꞌahwanoiyego ꞌabehega gona Paulo ꞌusuluheyawa ꞌidi ꞌetoꞌauta ꞌoina, ma ꞌabehega ꞌina puiyao sibese bwaibwaini.

Ta ꞌidi ꞌahwanoi sahena ꞌuhehesagohe, weyahina gide site poti siꞌedahwana ꞌedai Paulo weyahina, ta sigwaehemisa pwaiya ꞌabehega nata geya siꞌaiꞌai bo sinumanuma ꞌana siga Paulo siloheꞌamasa nugete. Ta siyamwayamwamo tagwala ꞌoiuwega siloba Paulo weyahina.”
Ta toloinaina ꞌigwaeya, “Yauwedo ꞌowa, ꞌutauya ma sahena ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌoina ꞌuhehepwaila ꞌabehega ꞌidi nuwatuhu dahwanaina ꞌuhepwaila pwaiya ꞌoiguwa.”
Paulo sihewasaeya Sisaliya ꞌoina gabana Pilikesa ꞌona

Ta boda ꞌaleha ꞌana toloina ꞌibwauwediya ꞌina toloꞌalehao ꞌadi tohanugeta ꞌeluwa ma ꞌiloinaediya, “Nata hinuwanega toloꞌaleha tu handeledi, ma togelu hosi sebeniti ma toꞌahala gita tu handeledi wete waheꞌautedima, ma sitauyegomi Sisaliya ꞌoina.
Ma hesi tupwana hosi wete waꞌewadi ma ꞌoinega Paulo ꞌigelu, ta maꞌina bwebweꞌana watauye gabana Pilikesa ꞌoina.”
Ta wete leta ꞌileleya bewa gide, ꞌigwaeya,
“Yauwedo ꞌowa gabana ꞌuhane hedada Pilikesa ꞌoiuwa, taugu Kolodiu Lisiyasi ꞌoiguwega.
Loheya bewa meYudiya siꞌabiyahiya ma ꞌiꞌiuna siloheꞌamasi, ta wasana yahesagoheya ꞌabehega tauna gwama Lomaina, ta toloꞌalehao baꞌidagwao ꞌatauya ꞌoidiya, ma nimadiyega ꞌalemeya.
Nuwanuwagu ꞌidi heꞌewaina huhuna yada sanapu, ta ꞌidi hegogona ꞌoina yaꞌeweyama,
ma yalobeya ꞌidi heꞌewa huhuna beno sigwaegwae taudi tuwa ꞌidi tapwalolo ꞌana loina weyahina, ta ꞌidi heꞌewa geya loheꞌamasa bo lagu deli ꞌilobwaine.

“Wasa wete yahesagoha pwaiya ꞌidi loina dahwana Paulo ꞌana loheꞌamasa weyahina, ꞌoinega yalomwayamwayau ma yahewasaeyawa ꞌoiuwa, ma ꞌana toheꞌewao wete yahegwaediya ma sitauyawa ꞌoiuwa, ma nobwa sihepwaila toꞌaha ꞌidi heꞌewa huhuna loheya bewa weyahina.”
Toloꞌaleha ꞌadi loina gide simulimuliyeya, ma Paulo hinuwanaina ꞌoina sitoeya Anitipatili ꞌoina.
Gona ꞌiꞌadaleya, ma tupwadi toloꞌalehaowedi sihila ꞌidi tupwa, ta togelu hosimo Paulo sitauyeya Sisaliya,
ta gabana ꞌina leta siꞌebwaeya, ta wete Paulo sitoeyama gabana matana.
Ta gabana ꞌina leta ꞌihasili hegumwaliya, ma Paulo ꞌihesilaleya, “Toꞌeha ꞌino ꞌasa?” Ta Paulo ꞌigwaeya, “Cigu ꞌasa Silisiya ꞌalona.”
Ta gabana ꞌigwaeya, “Ca toheꞌewao hesi sinaoma ma ꞌoinega ꞌimi yatala yapaihowa.” Ma toloꞌalehao ꞌiloinaediya ma Pauloina silomatayahi hada wasawasaina, mwalo Helodi ꞌina hada, ꞌoina.
